meta.form_validation: Held-out metrics evaluate original listings and their manufacturer/model fields; generated form descriptions are not separately validated.
meta.architecture: E5-large description only → Isolation Forest training filter → Extra Trees regression
meta.evaluation_scope: Pilot evaluation; remove half of training candidates only. Validation/test are unfiltered. Not directly comparable to previous full-cohort runs.
meta.filter_warning: Semantic anomaly is not evidence that a listing is incorrect. Removing 50% can discard valid rare vehicles and bias coverage.
